# CANDIDATE: SNIPER_REAL_FILLS_GRINDER_TOP_KEEPER

**Filed:** 2026-07-21
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** exit_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture edge by tightening exit parameters to take profits earlier and lock in gains sooner, while adjusting trigger parameters for better signal quality. The hypothesis is that exiting at 50% TP1 (vs. letting winners run) combined with a 5% profit-lock arm and 5% trailing stop will reduce losses on losing days (5/05, 5/06, 5/07) while still capturing partial gains on winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04). The trigger changes (vol_mult=1.1, body_min_cents=0.02, min_stars=2, strike_offset=2, proximity_dollars=1.5, require_break_above_open=true) aim to filter noise and improve entry precision.

## Mechanism

**Entry triggers:**  
- Volume multiplier ≥ 1.1× 20-bar average volume  
- Candlestick body ≥ 2 cents  
- Minimum 2 stars from sniper signal  
- Strike: OTM-2 put (strike_offset=2)  
- Entry within $1.5 of a named/level structure (proximity_dollars=1.5)  
- Require price to break above the day's open (require_break_above_open=true)  

**Exit logic:**  
- Premium stop: -10% (exit if premium drops to 90% of entry)  
- TP1: +50% premium (sell 50% of position at this level)  
- Runner target: +200% premium (theoretical max, but profit-lock likely activates sooner)  
- Profit-lock: arms at +5% gain, trails stop at 5% below high-water mark  
- Time stop: 15:50 ET
